name: screening-service
description: CargoDesk Sanctions/Screening Service — sanctions_entries (OFAC SDN + the US Consolidated Screening List) and sanctions_syncs, plus the two sync jobs and their self-scheduling auto-sync timers. Called only by the monolith over an internal, secret-gated HTTP API (see server.js's own /internal gate) — never exposed to the browser. Resolved dependencies (express) are hoisted from the repo root's node_modules — no separate install step.
